:::{#def-generalization-error}
#### Generalization error

The **generalization error** of a prediction rule $\fitted$
fitted to a training set $\mathcal{T}$
is its expected squared [prediction error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-error)
on a new observation $(X_0, Y_0)$
drawn from the same population independently of $\mathcal{T}$,
with $\mathcal{T}$ held fixed:

$$
\generr_{\mathcal{T}} \eqdef \E{\sqf{\fitted(X_0) - Y_0} \mid \mathcal{T}}.
$$ {#eq-generalization-error}

:::
